_meta.description: Mock system / SaaS service status. Keyed by service name (lowercase). Snapshot as of the run-time date.

_dependencies._description: Service-to-service dependency graph. A service depends on the listed services for its functionality. Agent uses this to traverse upstream when a service appears healthy but its consumers report problems.

incidents.summary: Elevated latency for Salesforce users in Chicago and Midwest regions. Page loads taking 30-60 seconds; record saves intermittently failing.
incidents.root_cause: Salesforce regional CDN node degradation in Midwest. Under investigation by Salesforce ops.
incidents.workaround: Connect via corporate VPN routed through East Coast egress; Salesforce Mobile app is unaffected.
incidents.eta: Salesforce engineering investigating; no firm ETA. Status updates at status.salesforce.com.

recent_changes.summary: Network firewall rule update across the corporate egress gateway. Goal: tighten allowlists for outbound traffic from internal CI agents.
recent_changes.potential_impact: Jenkins agents may experience timeouts when reaching internal artifact mirrors (Maven, PyPI, npm) or downstream systems if their target IPs were not included in the new allowlist.
